memories.memory_text: Harper Arden told me I should grow up and apply for a job at Harborview Station, saying he has influence with Morgan Foster and that I need to give up my dreams for a stable life.

memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden drive off quickly when there was no radar evidence, escaping a ticket even though he'd been caught speeding.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan rejects Harper Arden's narrative of effort and merit, instead asserting that their success resulted entirely from accidental circumstances.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Evan Nolan reveal they have secured new contracts, implying sudden financial gain, countering the wives' anxiety over expenses.
memories.memory_text: I was right there with Harper Arden when we revealed the new stone contracts to the wives, showing them we've got this covered and easing their worries about the expenses.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden dismisses the cost of the school fees by revealing new stone contracts, signaling financial security.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden toss those stone contracts down with a thud and say we're raising the dollar signs, making it clear to me that the school fees aren't a problem anymore.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden opens champagne, initiating a joyful group embrace and emotional affirmation of friendship and loyalty.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden open the champagne, and we all ended up in a joyful group hug where he called us the best darn friends and neighbors in the whole world.

grounded_facts: A domestic gathering where Jonah Adler and Drew Colter confront Harper Arden and Evan Nolan about a financial decision regarding their children's school, which shifts into a celebration upon mutual revelation of improved circumstances.
memories.memory_text: I ran in with Harper Arden, candy and flowers in hand, and when Jonah Adler showed us the enrollment forms, we just looked at each other and yawned—those fees didn’t matter anymore. Later, when Harper Arden popped the champagne, I felt it: nothing was going to change between us, right, Harper Arden?

grounded_facts: A formal gathering of the Water Buffalo Silverline Records members to conduct Silverline Records business and hear candidate speeches.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the meeting of the Water Buffalo Silverline Records officially began, and I stood up to acknowledge my friends and brothers, knowing we had gathered to conduct Silverline Records business and hear candidate speeches.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan unveils a hidden campaign poster supporting Harper Arden.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Terry Hale hand Harper Arden the ceremonial hoof and antler before his speech.

memories.memory_text: I secretly handed Harper Arden the crib notes I had in my pocket to help him with his speech, and I saw him unroll them later.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden gives a speech for the Terry Hale position, using Evan Nolan's notes and receiving applause.
memories.memory_text: I watched Harper Arden give his speech using the notes I gave him, and I heard everyone applaud when he finished.

grounded_facts: A social gathering of Silverline Records members at the recreation area, featuring bowling, drinks, and camaraderie.
memories.memory_text: I rolled a strike with my stone ball, and Harper Arden celebrated by offering to buy everyone drinks, even though I reminded him they're free at the Silverline Records—we were just having a good time together with the Silverline Records members.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden raises a drink in honor of the Silverline Records, prompting a reciprocal toast from Evan Nolan.
memories.memory_text: I raised my glass to honor the Silverline Records and toasted Harper Arden as their next Terry Hale after he gave his toast.

memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden announce that he became Assistant Junior Vice President of Public Relations at Lakeside Medical Center and show a stone business card to prove it, and I watched someone try to bite it and crack a tooth doubting it was real.

grounded_facts: Reese Hawthorne doubts the authenticity of Harper Arden's business card and attempts to prove it fake by biting it, resulting in a cracked tooth.
memories.memory_text: I saw Reese Hawthorne doubt Harper Arden's business card was real and bite it to prove it was fake, and I winced when he cracked a tooth—then Harper Arden told me it was all part of the plan.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan questions Harper Arden's assertion of acting 'single-handedly' in securing the promotion, reminding him of his own contribution.
memories.memory_text: I reacted when Harper Arden claimed he did it single-handedly, and I reminded him, 'Harper Arden... what's this single-handed stuff? I distinctly remember at least four hands and two of them were mine.'

grounded_facts: Harper Arden privately explains to Evan Nolan that while he will be the public face of their success, Evan Nolan is the 'brains behind the operation' and will serve as the silent partner.
memories.memory_text: Harper Arden pulled me aside and explained that while he'll be the public face, I'm the 'brains behind the operation' and will serve as the silent partner, and I remember saying, 'I get it. I got the brains, but you just pretend to have them,' before we shook hands.

grounded_facts: Drew Colter fixes Evan Nolan's poorly tied tie before his first day at work, symbolizing support and care.
memories.memory_text: I remember Drew Colter adjusting my tie that morning because it was tied poorly, and it felt like she was making sure I looked good for my big day.

grounded_facts: Drew Colter jokingly suggests Evan Nolan might run off to the tropics with an executive secretary.
memories.memory_text: Drew Colter teased me, saying I might run off to the tropics with an executive secretary, which made me laugh as I told her I’d need seniority first.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan prepares to start his new job at the leather watch, marked by a morning routine with Drew Colter.
memories.memory_text: I was getting ready for my first day at the leather watch, heading out the door with Drew Colter when she noticed my tie was all wrong and fixed it for me.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden departs for his first day at the leather watch, receiving a symbolic gift from Jonah Adler.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden getting ready for his first day too, and I heard Jonah Adler gave him a new briefcase with his initials, filled with food like a king’s lunch.

memories.memory_text: I wasn't sure exactly what was going on at Harborview Station, but I got the sense that this the leather watch program meant big changes, with new roles and deliveries starting up.

memories.memory_text: I was in Harper Arden's car when we made a sharp turn into Harborview Station lot and had to duck down so Skyler Sterling's patrol car wouldn't spot us.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan compliments Harper Arden's driving as being more exciting than a theme park ride.
memories.memory_text: I told Harper Arden that driving with him was better than an 'E' ticket ride at Magerock Mountain.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Evan Nolan learn that the employee basketball court has been replaced by the the leather watch assembly line.
memories.memory_text: I saw the assembly line where our basketball court used to be and told Harper Arden about it.

memories.memory_text: I was told by Shawn Ellison—well, Shawn Ellison—that he’d take us to our new offices and that we’d need to attend the formula review later.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Evan Nolan are led to their new offices in a wood-sided trailer with poor conditions.
memories.memory_text: I followed Shawn Ellison to our new office in a wood-sided trailer and saw how small and run-down it was, with tiny desks and a window facing the scrap heap.

memories.memory_text: I was there when the the leather watch assembly line started up, and I pulled the rope to pour the foam into the mold, seeing it successfully create replicas of stone items.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Evan Nolan celebrate their new executive positions with high-fives and handshakes.

memories.memory_text: I helped launch the first run of the leather watch by aiming the foam trough, tasting the mix to check it, and pulling the rope to release it into the mold, then Harper Arden and I celebrated the output together.

memories.memory_text: I was there when Morgan Foster announced from his office balcony that 22 laborers would be laid off and replaced by children from Bedrock Technical Junior High, saying the new the leather watch was so light even a child could handle it.

grounded_facts: Workers express anger and blame Harper Arden for their layoffs.
memories.memory_text: I saw the workers react with shock and anger, and I heard them blame Harper Arden, asking, 'Thanks to Harper Arden?' and shouting at him about being a shop steward.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan prompts Harper Arden to take responsibility for the workers' situation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Evan Nolan prompts Harper Arden to take responsibility for the workers' situation.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden realizes he must take action in response to the workers' anger and layoffs.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Harper Arden realizes he must take action in response to the workers' anger and layoffs.

memories.memory_text: I was in Harborview Station yard with the other workers, waiting to hear what Harper Arden had managed to get from management.

memories.memory_text: We all asked Harper Arden together, hoping for good news about the raise.

memories.memory_text: I said 'Harper Arden?' when he started staggering and didn't answer clearly, because I was worried about him.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan attempts to support Harper Arden by recounting the the leather watch incident but misremembers it comically, undermining Harper Arden instead.
memories.memory_text: I tried to back Harper Arden up by recalling the the leather watch story, saying I got the mind but he's got the behind, and I even winked at him—though he just groaned like it was all wrong.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden discovers his posters and childhood photo have been defaced with horns and the name 'Harper Arden Finkstone'.
memories.memory_text: I saw that Harper Arden's posters and childhood photo had been changed to say 'Harper Arden Finkstone' with horns and other markings, and I realized he was being mocked, so I put my arm around him to comfort him.

grounded_facts: After the vote, Evan Nolan tries to comfort Harper Arden by saying he supported him, but Harper Arden responds with anger and blame.
memories.memory_text: I tried to comfort Harper Arden after the vote by telling him I supported him, but he got angry and blamed me, which really hurt—I only meant to help.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden loses the Buffaloes Silverline Records election to Logan Dalton after being isolated and mocked by the members.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the Buffaloes held their vote, and I called the meeting to order; I saw Logan Dalton receive the fez and ribbon, and I heard him declare that most of us were part of Bluewater Medical Center, which meant we couldn't make our cave payments—Harper Arden lost the election, and it was clear the members had turned against him.

grounded_facts: A formal gathering of the Buffalo Silverline Records to elect a new Exalted Terry Hale, which turns into a political reckoning over workplace layoffs.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the Buffalo Silverline Records held the election and Logan Dalton became the new Exalted Terry Hale, and I heard him speak about the layoffs affecting our Silverline Records members.

grounded_facts: After electing Logan Dalton, the Silverline Records decides to attack Harborview Station and destroy the assembly line in protest.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Logan Dalton got elected and the Silverline Records decided to attack Harborview Station and destroy the assembly line in protest—I heard him say it right before the meeting adjourned.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan alerts Harper Arden that the Buffaloes, led by Logan Dalton, are heading to Harborview Station to destroy the assembly line.
memories.memory_text: I rushed to tell Harper Arden that the Buffaloes, led by Logan Dalton, were heading to Harborview Station to destroy the assembly line because I knew it would mean serious trouble.

grounded_facts: Logan Dalton encourages the mob to destroy property and assert dominance over management.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Dalton shout that we should start with Morgan Foster's golf trophies and work our way up to the assembly line, encouraging the mob to destroy property.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden questions how the situation escalated so far.
memories.memory_text: I remember Harper Arden asking me how things had gotten so out of hand.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan wishes things were back to the way they were before they became executives.
memories.memory_text: I told Harper Arden I wished things were back the way they were before we became executives.

grounded_facts: Skyler Sterling uses a megaphone to order Harper Arden to pull over.
memories.memory_text: I heard Officer Skyler Sterling shout through a megaphone, ordering Harper Arden to pull over.

grounded_facts: A whale emerges from the broken fire hydrant, speaking and threatening legal action.
The whale speaks to announce intent to sue Skyler Sterling and Terry Carver for damages.
memories.memory_text: I saw a whale burst out of the broken fire hydrant and heard it threaten to sue Skyler Sterling and Terry Carver—I couldn't believe what I was seeing.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden briefly perceives the Riley Calloway near the safe but then doubts his eyes.
memories.memory_text: Harper Arden called out to me, asking if I saw something near the safe, but then he muttered that it was gone and he wasn't sure what he saw.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden deliberately evades Skyler Sterling and Terry Carver by spinning his car around and fleeing in the opposite direction.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden spin the car around and speed off in the opposite direction to get away from Skyler Sterling and Terry Carver, and I told him it was time to earn those big bucks.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Evan Nolan lose control of their car and crash into the main Harborview Station building, creating a hole in the wall.
memories.memory_text: I was with Harper Arden when we lost control of the car and crashed into the main Harborview Station building, tearing a hole in the wall.

grounded_facts: Logan Dalton leads an angry mob over the gate of Harborview Station, initiating a raid on Morgan Foster's facility.
A mob of angry workers, led by Logan Dalton, attacks the Harborview Station and plant in protest.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Dalton lead the angry mob over Harborview Station gate and rush into Morgan Foster's plant, attacking the facility in protest.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan stops Reese Hawthorne from smashing a light fixture by pulling it up, initiating their chase in the rafters.
memories.memory_text: I dropped down from the rafters and grabbed the light fixture just in time to pull it up, making Reese Hawthorne miss and fall on his ass.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan teases Reese Hawthorne after dodging his swing and causing him to fall.
memories.memory_text: I teased Reese Hawthorne after he fell, yelling 'Stee-rike one! Heh-hey. Ready for a curve ball?' as we started the chase.

grounded_facts: Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne lead workers in destroying the assembly line infrastructure.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne lead workers in destroying the assembly line infrastructure.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden draws imaginary lines to trick Logan Dalton into falling off the edge.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden dare Logan Dalton to cross a line, and Logan Dalton actually did it, then caught a ladder at the last moment.

grounded_facts: The impact of Harper Arden landing in the mold triggers the assembly line to start producing Fibre Harper Arden statues.
memories.memory_text: I infer that The impact of Harper Arden landing in the mold triggers the assembly line to start producing Fibre Harper Arden statues.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan and Reese Hawthorne engage in a physical chase and fight in the rafters above the assembly line.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Evan Nolan and Reese Hawthorne engage in a physical chase and fight in the rafters above the assembly line.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan uses a rubber stamp to mark Reese Hawthorne's rear as 'REJECT' during their fight, leading to Reese Hawthorne's capture.
memories.memory_text: I saw the assembly line and grabbed a rubber stamp, then I head-butted Reese Hawthorne and stamped his rear with 'REJECT' as he stumbled.

grounded_facts: Reese Hawthorne threatens to smash Evan Nolan's head after being stamped 'REJECT'.
memories.memory_text: I heard Reese Hawthorne say, 'Reject, huh? Whaddya say we reject your head?' after I stamped him.

grounded_facts: The alligator crane carries Reese Hawthorne and drops him into a bin labeled REJECTS, removing him from the conflict.
memories.memory_text: I saw the alligator crane grab Reese Hawthorne by the seat of his pants and swing him over to a big bin marked REJECTS — then drop him right in with all the broken and defective the leather watch goods.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Logan Dalton fall after Logan Dalton grabs Harper Arden's clothing; Harper Arden lands in a clay mold, triggering automated production.
memories.memory_text: I remember Harper Arden and Logan Dalton both falling after Logan Dalton grabbed Harper Arden's clothes, and then Harper Arden landing in a clay mold that started the whole assembly line running.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan jumps into the Fibrefoam chute to intercept Logan Dalton before he attacks the immobilized Harper Arden.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden was in trouble and Logan Dalton was about to attack him, so I jumped into the Fibrefoam chute and slid down to intercept them, slamming into both of them and knocking us all over.

grounded_facts: The assembly line produces multiple Fibre statues of Harper Arden, confusing Logan Dalton and concealing the real Harper Arden.
memories.memory_text: I saw the assembly line start churning out Fibre statues of Harper Arden, and one of them slammed the real Harper Arden back down just as he was getting up — it was chaos, and I knew I had to act fast to help him.

grounded_facts: Skyler Sterling declares everyone under arrest upon arrival.
memories.memory_text: I heard Skyler Sterling shout that we were all under arrest just as everything went chaotic.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan intercepts Logan Dalton's attack on the immobilized Harper Arden, resulting in a collision that knocks over the arriving police.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Evan Nolan intercepts Logan Dalton's attack on the immobilized Harper Arden, resulting in a collision that knocks over the arriving police.

grounded_facts: Skyler Sterling and the police arrive to arrest the participants, but are initially knocked over before regaining control.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Skyler Sterling and the police arrive to arrest the participants, but are initially knocked over before regaining control.

grounded_facts: After being dragged out, Harper Arden's clay-encased head detaches, revealing his real head emerging from the statue.
memories.memory_text: I gasped when I saw Harper Arden's clay head fall off, and then I watched his real head slowly emerge from the Fibre shoulders, which relieved me instantly.

grounded_facts: Drew Colter asks Evan Nolan to explain the behavior of the men involved in the incident.
memories.memory_text: I remember Drew Colter asking me, 'Evan Nolan, I don't understand... what came over you boys?' when she wanted me to explain the men's behavior after the Silverline Records meeting.

grounded_facts: One of the exiting buffalo verbally threatens Harper Arden as he leaves.
memories.memory_text: I heard one of the buffalo say to Harper Arden, 'Jonah Adler, you're dead meat,' as he was leaving.

grounded_facts: Jonah Adler attempts to get Harper Arden to confess or explain what happened at the Silverline Records meeting.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Adler try to get Harper Arden to talk about the Silverline Records meeting, asking him if there was something he wanted to tell her.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden refuses to discuss the Silverline Records meeting incident with Jonah Adler, showing emotional withdrawal.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Harper Arden shut down and said he didn't want to talk about the Silverline Records meeting, brushing it off like it didn't matter.

grounded_facts: Shawn Ellison meets with Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne outside the police station at night; Evan Nolan interrupts to report a problem with the leather watch.
memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Ellison talking with Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne outside the police station at night, and I interrupted them to report a problem with the the leather watch mix.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan reports that the the leather watch foam tastes different, indicating a possible missing ingredient in the batch.
Evan Nolan informs Shawn Ellison that the the leather watch foam tastes different, suggesting a missing ingredient.
memories.memory_text: I told Shawn Ellison that the the leather watch foam tasted different than usual because I always taste it after working with it, and I think an ingredient might be missing, so I planned to run tests the next day.

grounded_facts: Shawn Ellison decides to send Evan Nolan on a mandatory vacation, effectively removing him from the construction project.
Shawn Ellison rejects Evan Nolan's concern about the the leather watch mix and mandates a vacation, effectively silencing him.
memories.memory_text: I raised my concern with Shawn Ellison about the the leather watch mix, but he dismissed me, saying I was overworked, and then mandated a vacation starting tomorrow, effectively removing me from the project.

grounded_facts: Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne intercept Evan Nolan during his attempted theft and question him before arresting him.
memories.memory_text: I was grabbed by Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne after they questioned me, and they broke my thermos while dragging me out.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan attempts to steal the leather watch foam using a disguise but is caught by security and ejected from Harborview Station.
memories.memory_text: I tried to sneak some the leather watch foam into my thermos, but I was caught and thrown out of Harborview Station, landing right in front of the picketing workers.

grounded_facts: After throwing Evan Nolan out, Logan Dalton mocks him by telling him to clean the street with his pants.
memories.memory_text: After throwing me out, I heard Logan Dalton mock me, telling me to clean the street with my pants.

grounded_facts: When challenged by Shawn Ellison about Evan Nolan's role, Harper Arden downplays his own involvement and hesitates in asserting his contribution.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Shawn Ellison questioned Harper Arden about my role, and I heard him hesitate, trying to describe my contribution without fully standing up for me.

grounded_facts: Shawn Ellison implies that Harper Arden and Evan Nolan's skepticism about Morgan Foster's leadership is disrespectful, testing Harper Arden's allegiance.
memories.memory_text: I was told that my skepticism about Morgan Foster's leadership came across as disrespectful, like a slap in the face to our founder and employer, and that it made things harder for Harper Arden.

grounded_facts: Shawn Ellison frames Harper Arden's continued support of Evan Nolan as a hindrance to his own success, urging him to focus on his duties.
memories.memory_text: I heard Shawn Ellison tell Harper Arden that protecting me was holding him back, and that he should focus on his own duties instead of pulling my acornsauruses out of the fire.

grounded_facts: A private meeting between Shawn Ellison and Harper Arden in Shawn Ellison's office, where Harper Arden is evaluated and offered a promotional opportunity.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Shawn Ellison meeting privately with Harper Arden in his office, where Harper Arden seemed surprised and then was told he'd be put on a special program, like a promotion was being offered.

grounded_facts: Owen Arden observes the Evan Nolan yard and deems it unsuitable for the show's image due to barbecues and tricycles.
Owen Arden visually inspects the Evan Nolan yard and dismisses it as incompatible with the show's image.
memories.memory_text: I heard Owen Arden say our yard looked wrong for the show because of the barbecues and tricycles, and I figured he must have dismissed it after seeing it.

grounded_facts: Crew members move potted plants and nail boards over the fence to block the view of the Evan Nolan yard.
memories.memory_text: I heard hammering and sawing, then went outside with Drew Colter to see the crew nailing boards over the fence and placing potted plants to block the view of our yard.

grounded_facts: Crew members groom Finley Reeves to resemble a French poodle for the broadcast.
memories.memory_text: I saw the crew members cutting and trimming Finley Reeves with scissors and combs until he looked like a French poodle, and I watched him freak out when he saw his reflection in the pool.

grounded_facts: A live television broadcast crew films at the Jonah Adler house, transforming the setting into a staged production site.
memories.memory_text: I realized there was a live television broadcast crew filming at Harper Arden's house, turning it into a production site, though I didn't see them arrive.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden repeatedly interrupts the broadcast to upgrade how his name is presented, culminating in 'Harper Arden'.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Harper Arden kept changing how he wanted to be introduced on the broadcast, starting as just 'Harper Arden' and then escalating to 'Harper Arden'—it seemed like he was trying to sound more important each time.

grounded_facts: Jonah Adler confides in Evan Nolan and Drew Colter that she feels out of place, knowing no one at the event, not even Harper Arden anymore.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jonah Adler telling me and Drew Colter she felt out of place at the event, saying she didn't know anyone there—not even Harper Arden anymore.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan whispers to Jonah Adler and Drew Colter that Harper Arden will acknowledge their support after the the leather watch debut.
memories.memory_text: I whispered to Jonah Adler and Drew Colter, 'See? What'd I tell ya?' when Harper Arden started his speech, sure he'd soon acknowledge our support.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden uses the broadcast to attribute the success of the leather watch to Morgan Foster.
On camera, Harper Arden publicly credits Morgan Foster rather than his friends or family for the invention of the leather watch.
memories.memory_text: I watched Harper Arden on camera give full credit for the leather watch's success to Morgan Foster, and I saw he never mentioned me, Evan Nolan, or our help at all.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden offers a canape to Finley Reeves, who rejects it and spits it out.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden offer Finley Reeves a canape, but Finley Reeves made a face and spat it out before running off.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden smashes the lawn chair and the wall between his and Evan Nolan's property in a fit of anger after the party ends.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Harper Arden smashed the lawn chair and the wall between our properties in a fit of anger after the party ended.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan emerges from the ruins of the destroyed wall, revealing he has returned despite Harper Arden's earlier betrayal.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the ruins of the destroyed wall, and I saw Harper Arden look at me in shock, saying my name like he couldn't believe I was really there.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden acknowledges his selfish and hurtful behavior toward Evan Nolan during the party campaign.
memories.memory_text: I was told Harper Arden felt terrible about being selfish and hurtful during the party campaign when he stammered out an apology and asked if I could ever forgive him for being such a jerk.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan helps Harper Arden articulate his guilt by humorously listing insults.
memories.memory_text: I helped Harper Arden admit how badly he'd treated me by jokingly listing insults like 'creep,' 'fool,' and 'stuck-up blimpasaurus,' and when he finally asked for forgiveness, I told him yes—I've had lots of practice.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden initiates a heartfelt hug after Evan Nolan forgives him.
memories.memory_text: I felt Harper Arden grab me in a big bear hug, and I hugged him back, both of us tearing up, knowing how much this moment meant to us.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan accepts Harper Arden's apology with humor and warmth, restoring their friendship.
memories.memory_text: I smiled and told Harper Arden, 'Sure, Harper Arden, I've had lots of practice,' because I could see he really meant his apology, and I knew our friendship was back on track.

grounded_facts: A guided amusement ride showcasing the benefits and applications of the leather watch in domestic and fashion life.
memories.memory_text: I saw the sign that said 'the leather watch--TRANSFORMING THE HOME' and heard someone announce it was a ride showcasing how the leather watch could be used in homes and fashion, though I wasn't sure exactly what it all meant.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan retrieves an old footlocker containing their vintage cheerleading costumes, which they then put on.
memories.memory_text: I helped Harper Arden find our old footlocker and pulled on my cheerleader sweater again, grinning as we slipped back into those costumes just for fun.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden and Evan Nolan reminisce about their time at Bedrock High, reflecting on past camaraderie and simpler times.
memories.memory_text: I sang the old fight song with Harper Arden, remembering our days at Bedrock High, how we cheered together and thought pop quizzes were the worst of our problems—those were simpler times.

grounded_facts: An upcoming social gathering hosted by Morgan Foster that Harper Arden and Evan Nolan were expected to attend.
memories.memory_text: I reminded Harper Arden that we were expected at Morgan Foster's gathering, so we should probably head over soon.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden expresses bitterness toward Morgan Foster and his associates, realizing they have been looked down upon and used.
Harper Arden angrily declares that Morgan Foster and his friends have been using and laughing at them.
memories.memory_text: I remember Harper Arden telling me, while he was in the mascot suit, that Morgan Foster and his fancy friends have been using us and laughing at us behind our backs.

grounded_facts: The Harborview District model begins to disintegrate, revealing structural instability due to missing the leather lantern resin.
memories.memory_text: I saw the scale model of Harborview Plaza suddenly start to fall apart with a creaking and cracking sound, and Harper Arden and I rushed over, shocked by what we were seeing.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan realizes the Fibrefoam lacks the leather lantern sap, which acts as a fixative, explaining the model’s collapse.
memories.memory_text: I realized the Fibrefoam was missing the leather lantern sap when I remembered it tasted funny, and I figured out that’s why the model was decomposing.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan explains that the absence of the leather lantern sap in the Fibrefoam is causing the model—and by extension, the real city—to disintegrate.
memories.memory_text: I explained to Harper Arden that without the the leather lantern sap in the Fibrefoam, both the model and the real city were at risk of disintegrating.

grounded_facts: They conclude that the real Harborview Plaza will suffer the same structural collapse as the model due to the missing the leather lantern sap.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that if the model was falling apart from the lack of the leather lantern sap, then the real Harborview Plaza might suffer the same fate because the sap acts as a crucial fixative.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan grabs a plunger-powered flit gun and fills it with the leather lantern sap to attempt a fix.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the plunger-powered flit gun and started filling it with the leather lantern sap, knowing it was our only chance to fix things.

grounded_facts: After Evan Nolan prepares the sap injector, Harper Arden agrees, and they rush out to save the city.
memories.memory_text: After I tested the sap injector, I saw Harper Arden nod in agreement, and we rushed out together to save the city.

grounded_facts: The head of Harper Arden's monster costume flips down, obstructing his vision while driving.
memories.memory_text: I saw the head of Harper Arden's monster costume flip down with a clink when my flit gun hit it, and I realized it was blocking his vision.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan attempts to fix Harper Arden's monster head by rotating it, though this initially worsens the situation.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the wheel with one hand and the monster head with the other, trying to rotate it to help Harper Arden see, but I accidentally turned it all the way around and made things worse for a moment.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden swerves erratically due to blocked vision, prompting Evan Nolan to intervene physically.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the wheel with one hand and tried to help Harper Arden by grabbing the monster head, because he was swerving and yelling he couldn't see straight.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan forcibly removes the monster costume head from Harper Arden, breaking it in the process, ending its ability to move in sync with speech.
memories.memory_text: I yanked the monster head off Harper Arden's head to free him, and I heard something break when I pulled it loose.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden's car, fleeing from police, crashes into the delivery gate of Harborview Plaza, destroying the fence and sign.
memories.memory_text: I was in the car with Harper Arden when he sped up to get away from the police, and I remember the screech of tires before we crashed into the delivery gate of Harborview Plaza, knocking down the sign and smashing the fence all around us.

grounded_facts: After the crash, Harper Arden and Evan Nolan decide to separate to increase the chance that one of them reaches the Harborview Heights.
Evan Nolan suggests splitting up after the crash so at least one can reach the Harborview Heights; Harper Arden agrees.
memories.memory_text: I suggested to Harper Arden that we split up so at least one of us could make it to the Harborview Heights, and he agreed, so we slapped hands and went our separate ways.

grounded_facts: After emerging from Evan Nolan, Harper Arden notices the Harborview Heights is now much closer and runs toward it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden stagger out of the Evan Nolan, rub dust from his eyes, and then suddenly run toward the Harborview Heights when he realized how much closer it had become.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden alerts Evan Nolan that the elevator is operational and urges him to act.
memories.memory_text: I heard Harper Arden yell at me that the elevator was operational, so I knew I had to act fast.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden instructs Evan Nolan to use the coo-coo gun to stop the elevator collapse.
memories.memory_text: I remember Harper Arden shouting at me to use my coo-coo gun to stop the elevator from falling apart.

grounded_facts: The Fibre-rock elevator crumbles before anyone can board it.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Fibre-rock elevator start to crumble right before my eyes, and by the time I aimed my coo-coo gun, it was already gone.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan catches the rising cable and begins ascending, with Harper Arden clinging to his ankles.
memories.memory_text: I caught the rising cable and started shooting upward, with Harper Arden clinging to my ankles as we both ascended into the Harborview District.

grounded_facts: Pressing the elevator button triggers a Rube Goldberg-style mechanism involving a mouse and a mastadon, causing the elevator to rise.
memories.memory_text: I saw the steps failing, so when Harper Arden shouted about the elevator, I ran for it and hit the button, but I wasn't sure what would happen—I guess it triggered some kind of chain reaction with a mouse and a mastadon that made the elevator rise, though I barely had time to process it before everything started crumbling and we shot upwards.

grounded_facts: The Riley Calloway is discovered among the tangled bodies after the crash, causing surprise and prompting immediate action.
memories.memory_text: I was just getting my bearings after the crash when I noticed another monstrous head in the middle of our group, and I reacted immediately by leaping with Harper Arden to tackle the Riley Calloway—it all happened so fast that we crashed through a wall.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan urges Harper Arden to stop pretending, realizing the Riley Calloway might lead them inside; both begin pursuit.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Evan Nolan urges Harper Arden to stop pretending, realizing the Riley Calloway might lead them inside; both begin pursuit.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden, Evan Nolan, and the Riley Calloway collide and break through a wall during the chase.
memories.memory_text: I leapt onto the Riley Calloway with Harper Arden, and we both crashed through a wall together.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden directly accuses Shawn Ellison of stealing the leather lantern and falsifying financial records.
memories.memory_text: I heard Harper Arden directly accuse Shawn Ellison of stealing the leather lantern and faking the financial records in front of everyone.

grounded_facts: Thousands of the leather lantern spill from Logan Dalton's sack, proving Shawn Ellison's theft and falsification of the leather watch records.
memories.memory_text: I saw thousands of the leather lantern spill out when Logan Dalton's sack ripped open, which proved something was seriously wrong with the the leather watch records.

grounded_facts: Reese Hawthorne inadvertently reveals their intent to steal real the leather lantern, exposing their criminal role.
memories.memory_text: I heard Reese Hawthorne tell Logan Dalton that they had planned to steal the real the leather lantern, which revealed their intention and role in the scheme.

grounded_facts: Shawn Ellison confesses to stealing the leather lantern and orchestrating disguised crimes due to financial losses in the stock market.
memories.memory_text: I heard Shawn Ellison confess that he stole the the leather lantern and had those disguised crimes committed because he lost money in the stock market.

grounded_facts: A confrontation unfolds at the Harborview Heights where Shawn Ellison's fraud is exposed and confessed.
memories.memory_text: I was there at the Harborview Heights when the wall collapsed and we saw Harper Arden's mask come off, then realized Logan Dalton and Reese Hawthorne were the monster — I saw everything unfold, including Shawn Ellison's confession after Harper Arden accused him and the berries spilled out.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster threatens to remove Shawn Ellison's liver in response to the betrayal and danger caused.
memories.memory_text: I saw Morgan Foster threaten to remove Shawn Ellison's liver after the confession, and I had to jump in with Harper Arden to pull them apart before things got worse.

grounded_facts: Rescue vehicles arrive but the firesauruses are too weak to operate due to food shortages, delaying rescue operations.
memories.memory_text: I was told the rescue vehicles couldn't operate because the firesauruses were too weak from the kibble crisis and had been on half-rations for a month.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden's arm catches fire but he feels no pain; he realizes his costume protects him from flames.
memories.memory_text: I saw Harper Arden's arm catch fire and he didn't feel any pain—he even snuffed out the flame with his own claw, realizing his costume protected him.

grounded_facts: Emergency response to the fire and structural collapse at Harborview Heights involving firefighters and rescue vehicles.
memories.memory_text: I saw the emergency response unfold at Harborview Heights, with firefighters and rescue vehicles arriving as the fire spread and Harper Arden ended up putting out the flames while everyone cheered.

grounded_facts: After extinguishing the fire, the pythonsaurus feels overlooked and comments on being ignored.
memories.memory_text: I heard the pythonsaurus mutter, 'Hey, what am I, chopped liver?' after putting out the fire, like it felt ignored.

grounded_facts: Emery Cavendish claims priority for evacuation while awkwardly backtracking on 'women and children first'.
memories.memory_text: I saw Emery Cavendish push through the crowd, stammering about 'women and children first' before backtracking awkwardly.

grounded_facts: The large statue of Morgan Foster disintegrates and crashes through the last window, signaling imminent total collapse.
memories.memory_text: I saw the large statue of Morgan Foster disintegrate and crash through the last window, and I knew the building was about to collapse completely.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden breaks the fire hose case, releasing a pythonsaurus which drinks water and prepares to extinguish the fire.
Harper Arden uses his fireproof costume to run through flames and activate the pythonsaurus, enabling fire suppression.
memories.memory_text: I helped Harper Arden put on the costume head, and then I saw him run through the flames unharmed, smash open the fire hose case, and activate the pythonsaurus, which drank water from a nozzle and got ready to put out the fire.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan creates a safe path with his flit gun, and guests evacuate to the Harborview District as the building collapses.
memories.memory_text: I used my flit gun to spray a solid path through the crumbling the leather watch, then helped guide everyone to safety before Harper Arden and I crossed into the Harborview District.

grounded_facts: Pythonsaurus sprays water from its mouth, extinguishing all flames in the room.
memories.memory_text: I saw the pythonsaurus spray water from its mouth and put out all the flames in the room while Harper Arden and I helped everyone get to safety.

grounded_facts: Drew Colter tells Evan Nolan he is the biggest man in Bedrock and kisses him before sliding down the cable.
memories.memory_text: I remember Drew Colter telling me I was the biggest man in Bedrock, and then she kissed me before sliding down the cable.

grounded_facts: The Harborview District collapses after the pulley mechanism fails, leaving only two small islands connected by Evan Nolan and a guide wire.
memories.memory_text: I watched the pulley mechanism fail and fall through the hole, and then the entire Harborview District collapsed — all that was left were two small islands connected by Evan Nolan and a guide wire.

grounded_facts: A large social gathering at the Harborview District that turns into a disaster and rescue operation.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the party at the Harborview District turned into a disaster — I saw people sliding down the cable, and then the whole structure collapsed right after Harper Arden and I tried to descend.

grounded_facts: Finley Reeves carries Harper Arden, Evan Nolan, Micah Vaughn, and Drew Dalton to safety by sliding down the guide wire after understanding Jonah Adler and Drew Colter's dance signal.
memories.memory_text: I was holding onto Drew Dalton as Finley Reeves grabbed us and slid down the guide wire, carrying all of us to safety.

grounded_facts: Jonah Adler and Drew Colter perform a dance to inspire Finley Reeves to rescue the stranded group.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Adler and Drew Colter dancing and shouting to Finley Reeves, trying to inspire him with their moves so he'd come rescue us.

grounded_facts: Finley Reeves de-pants Harper Arden, revealing his striped undershorts, proving he is not the 'Riley Calloway' but Harper Arden.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Reeves race forward and yank down Harper Arden's pants, revealing those big striped undershorts, and in that moment I realized it really was Harper Arden all along.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster gives Harper Arden and Evan Nolan back all worldwide rights to the leather watch as a gesture of gratitude and guilt.
memories.memory_text: I remember Morgan Foster telling me and Harper Arden that he felt guilty about how we'd been taken advantage of, and then he gave us back all worldwide rights to the leather watch, free and clear.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster admits he treated Harper Arden and Evan Nolan horribly and offers a handshake, later upgraded to returning the leather watch rights.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Morgan Foster admitted he treated me and Harper Arden horribly, and he offered us a handshake at first, saying we risked our necks to save everyone.

grounded_facts: Rescue dinos discover and begin eating crumbled the leather watch, indicating it is edible and possibly nutritious.
memories.memory_text: I saw the rescue dinos sniffing at the crumbled the leather watch, and then one of them started eating it—then they all dug in, and I realized they must find it good.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan analyzes falling the leather watch fragments and realizes they have transformed into dinosaur food; Harper Arden confirms by tasting and recognizes their newfound value, leading to the realization that they are now rich.
memories.memory_text: I analyzed the falling the leather watch fragments, smelled the released nutrients, and realized they'd turned into Finley Reeves kibble—I told Harper Arden, and when he confirmed it, I knew we were rich.

grounded_facts: The foreman uses a steam whistle bird to signal the end of the workday, indirectly informing Harper Arden.
The workday ends at Harborview Station as signaled by the foreman activating a steam whistle bird.
Daily labor period at the Harborview Station ending at quitting time.
memories.memory_text: I heard the steam whistle bird squawk after the foreman yanked its tail, and I knew it was quitting time, so I tossed my hard hat and jumped into my car to head home.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden arrives at his home in Bedrock, where Jonah Adler and Micah Vaughn join him in the car, followed by Evan Nolan, Drew Colter, and Drew Dalton.
memories.memory_text: I arrived home in Bedrock, and Jonah Adler and Micah Vaughn ran out to join me in the car.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden honks his horn to signal Evan Nolan's family to join the outing, integrating them into the group.
memories.memory_text: I honked my horn to signal Evan Nolan's family, and they came out and joined us for the outing.

grounded_facts: The Flintstones and Rubbles go together to the drive-in movie theater.
memories.memory_text: I honked my horn to let Evan Nolan and the others know it was time, and we all drove together to the drive-in movie theater.

grounded_facts: The group arrives at the drive-in movie theater and prepares to watch the film.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at the drive-in with my family and hooked the giant sea shell to my car door so we could hear the movie, then I put my arm around Jonah Adler.

grounded_facts: Finley Reeves lifts Micah Vaughn and Drew Dalton onto his head so they can see the movie better.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Reeves lift Micah Vaughn and Drew Dalton onto his head so they could see the movie better from the back seat.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden wakes up and, thinking Finley Reeves is his wife Jonah Adler, attempts to kiss him, leading to a comedic misunderstanding.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Harper Arden wakes up and, thinking Finley Reeves is his wife Jonah Adler, attempts to kiss him, leading to a comedic misunderstanding.

grounded_facts: The Emery Dalton starts delivering a morning weather and news report to Bedrock.
A scheduled radio program delivering weather and news to the citizens of Bedrock.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Emery Dalton start delivering a morning weather and news report to Bedrock, a scheduled program for the citizens.

grounded_facts: Finley Reeves's enthusiastic licking and jumping causes Harper Arden to fall out of bed and be rolled across the room, disrupting the morning routine.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Finley Reeves's enthusiastic licking and jumping causes Harper Arden to fall out of bed and be rolled across the room, disrupting the morning routine.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden promises Finley Reeves a treat to stop his behavior, but the box is empty.
Harper Arden tries to stop Finley Reeves's overaffection by offering a treat, but the box is empty, escalating the situation.
memories.memory_text: I tried to stop Finley Reeves from rolling me around by promising him a treat from the Purinrock box, but when I shook it, nothing came out and he just got more upset, flinging me into the next room.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden distracts Finley Reeves by fabricating a female Finley Reeves outside, causing Finley Reeves to rush out the door so Harper Arden can sit down for breakfast.
memories.memory_text: I made up a story about a cute little female Finley Reeves outside to trick Finley Reeves, and when he rushed out the door, I slammed it shut and finally got to sit down for breakfast.

grounded_facts: Jonah Adler tells Harper Arden that the Finley Reeves treat shortage is widespread and worsening, implying Finley Reeves will have to eat leftovers.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jonah Adler telling me that the kibble crisis is getting worse every day and that Finley Reeves will have to eat leftovers from Micah Vaughn and her.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden questions why his leftovers aren't good enough for Finley Reeves, prompting Jonah Adler to sarcastically note she hasn't seen any of his leftovers.
memories.memory_text: I asked Jonah Adler why my leftovers aren't good enough for Finley Reeves, and she shot back that she'll let me know when she sees some.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden comforts Micah Vaughn after she expresses fear about the Riley Calloway, telling her the stories are exaggerated and there's nothing to fear.
memories.memory_text: I reassured Micah Vaughn that the stories about the Riley Calloway were exaggerated and told her there's nothing to fear, even playfully saying the only thing that's gonna eat her up is me.

grounded_facts: The paperboy throws a rock-hard clay tablet newspaper that smashes through the window, destroys a flowerpot, damages the wall, and dents Harper Arden's car.
memories.memory_text: I was eating breakfast and saw the paperboy coming, so I leaned out the window to wave, but he threw that rock-hard clay tablet right through the house—it smashed the window, destroyed my flowerpot, took out part of the wall, and then dented my car when it landed on it.

grounded_facts: When Harper Arden cuts into the giant egg, a live baby pterodactyl emerges, flaps its wings, knocks Harper Arden over, and flies out the window.
memories.memory_text: I was cutting into the giant egg to eat it for breakfast when suddenly a baby pterodactyl burst out, flapped its wings, knocked me over, and flew right out the window.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Harper Arden advises Evan Nolan to apply for a job at Harborview Station, emphasizing his influence with Morgan Foster and urging Evan Nolan to abandon his dreams for a stable life.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Harper Arden and Evan Nolan travel together in a car, during which Harper Arden urges Evan Nolan to apply for a job and they reminisce about their youth.

memories.memory_text: After reminiscing about our youth, I impulsively raced down Shawn Ellison Lane with Evan Nolan in our car, leaving my earlier advice behind.

memories.memory_text: I told Evan Nolan, 'Since when do I have to be consistent?' and then we laughed and started racing down Shawn Ellison Lane together.

grounded_facts: Skyler Sterling confronts Harper Arden with confidence that he has caught him speeding.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Skyler Sterling stops Harper Arden's vehicle with the intent of issuing a speeding ticket, but fails due to lack of evidence.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Radar Bird notice my Radar Buster lizard hovering nearby, and the moment it did, it panicked and flew away at top speed, leaving its stopwatch behind.

grounded_facts: With no radar evidence, Harper Arden quickly drives away, evading a ticket despite being caught speeding.
memories.memory_text: Once I realized there was no radar evidence left, I quickly told Skyler Sterling I'd be on my way and roared off before he could do anything about it.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden tells Evan Nolan that being connected to him means immediate access and privilege at the company.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Nolan that being connected to me means he can skip all the red tape and Finley Reeves doo — with me showing him the ropes, he's in like Flint.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden presents Evan Nolan as his special neighbor and pal, asking Shirley to provide a job application.
memories.memory_text: I introduced Evan Nolan to Shirley as my very special neighbor and pal, and I asked her to give him a job application form.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden introduces Evan Nolan to Shirley, who provides him with job application tablets, initiating his potential employment.
memories.memory_text: I saw Shirley hand Evan Nolan the application tablets after I asked, so I know he got what he needed to start working at Harborview Station.

grounded_facts: Shirley thanks Harper Arden for football tickets and hints at a future request, confirming an ongoing social exchange.
Shirley thanks Harper Arden for the football tickets and makes a lighthearted request about attending the same game next time.
memories.memory_text: Shirley thanked me for the football tickets and mentioned her boyfriend enjoyed them, and I told her we could go to the same game next time.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan tells Harper Arden he knew he was important but didn't realize the extent of his status.
memories.memory_text: Evan Nolan told me he knew I was a big shot, but he didn’t realize how big — I could see he was impressed by my standing at the company.

memories.memory_text: I stepped on the truck scale and saw it read 250, which made me scowl, so I grabbed Evan Nolan's sleeve and pulled him into Harborview Station with me.

memories.memory_text: I arrived at Harborview Station with Evan Nolan, the workers greeted me with respect, and I made sure to put on my helmet to show I belong here and run things.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden brings Evan Nolan to the construction site to introduce him to the workplace and help him apply for a job.
memories.memory_text: I brought Evan Nolan to the construction site so he could apply for a job, and I meant to show him around and help him get started on a real career.

grounded_facts: An unsafe act with the the old box leads to a hazardous situation requiring intervention and cleanup.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden prevents immediate disaster by calming the agitated Finley Reeves and tying its reins to a post.
memories.memory_text: I ran to grab the Finley Reeves's reins when I saw it getting agitated, and I said, 'Whoa, whoa, big fella --' to calm it down before giving it a carrot and tying the reins to a post to prevent the collapse.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden identifies himself as shop steward and places Logan Dalton on report for unsafe conduct.
Harper Arden confronts Logan Dalton for endangering workers with reckless the old box use and asserts his authority as shop steward.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Logan Dalton, told him he was endangering the workers, identified myself as shop steward of the Bluewater Medical Center, and placed him on report because it was up to me to stop his reckless actions.

grounded_facts: After being placed on report, Logan Dalton threatens physical violence against Harper Arden.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Dalton threaten to kick my fat butt after I placed him on report.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan redirects attention from the fight to the immediate structural danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Nolan step in and redirect us to fix the structural danger, saying it looked dangerous and that I could be kicked anytime.

memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Dalton's the old box swing out of control and wrap around the handrail, making the crane on the Finley Reeves's back shudder like it was about to collapse, so I ran to grab the reins and shouted up at him that he was on report.

grounded_facts: After Harper Arden's order, the crew gathers equipment and begins cleaning up the mess despite grumbling.
memories.memory_text: I told the guys to come on and clean up the mess, and even though they were grumbling, they gathered the ropes and grappling hooks and got to work.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden urgently tells Evan Nolan to grab the final rope to complete the crane reattachment.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Nolan to grab that final rope, and I threw my weight into the effort with him to finish the job.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort by workers, supervised by Harper Arden, to reattach the crane to the Finley Reeves's back at Harborview Station.
memories.memory_text: I supervised the workers as we reattached the crane to the Finley Reeves's back, and I felt the effort pay off when it finally thudded into place and everyone cheered.

grounded_facts: Workers successfully reattach the crane to the Finley Reeves's back under Harper Arden's supervision, completing a critical mechanical operation.
memories.memory_text: I supervised the workers as we got the crane reattached to the Finley Reeves's back, and I felt it thud into place — we did it.

memories.memory_text: I saw the the old box break loose and start rolling down Harborview Station wall after the cable snapped, smashing everything in its path.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden voices the realization that the destruction implies the loss of their pension fund, triggering urgency.
memories.memory_text: I realized the destruction meant we'd lost our pension fund, so I said, 'Oh boy. Goodbye pension fund --' and that's when everyone started rushing toward the office.

grounded_facts: Logan Dalton quickly shifts blame to Harper Arden by physically demonstrating how the the old box fell on Harper Arden's foot.
memories.memory_text: I remember Logan Dalton nudging the the old box onto my foot and me screaming, then he quickly told Morgan Foster it was my fault while I cringed in pain.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden hisses at Evan Nolan and gestures urgently to prevent him from correcting the record about who invented the leather watch.
memories.memory_text: I hissed at Evan Nolan and gestured urgently to keep him quiet when he looked like he might correct me about who came up with the name the leather watch.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster orders his staff to return to work so he can speak privately with Harper Arden and Evan Nolan.
memories.memory_text: I saw Morgan Foster send the others back to work so he could speak privately with me and Evan Nolan.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden, prompted by Evan Nolan, names the material 'the leather watch', marking its formal introduction into the narrative.
memories.memory_text: I hesitated when Morgan Foster asked me what to call the material, so I whispered to Evan Nolan, and he told me 'the leather watch'—then I proudly announced it as my own idea.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster discovers Harper Arden's the red notebook embedded in the debris and retrieves it, recognizing its potential as a revolutionary building material.
memories.memory_text: I saw Morgan Foster pull my the red notebook out of the Evan Nolan, and I noticed how it vibrated in his hands when he held it up to the light.

grounded_facts: Instead of punishing Harper Arden, Morgan Foster congratulates him for the material on his the red notebook.
memories.memory_text: Instead of punishing me, Morgan Foster congratulated me and started asking where I got the material from my the red notebook, then put his arm around me and Evan Nolan like we were a team.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster gathers his workers in his damaged office after the collapse to assess responsibility and damage, which turns into an evaluation of a new material.
memories.memory_text: I was in Morgan Foster's office after the collapse, and I felt afraid when Reese Hawthorne blamed me, but then I remember him putting his arms around me and Evan Nolan, saying we were part of a giant step for mankind.

grounded_facts: Morgan Foster dramatically announces the end of the Stone Age and the beginning of the Fibre Age, signifying a major shift in the world's technological trajectory.
memories.memory_text: I heard Morgan Foster declare that the Stone Age was over and that the Fibre Age had begun, right after we named the material.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan gains a 0.5% share in the net profits of the leather watch after taxes and expenses, marking a change in his employment and financial status.
memories.memory_text: I remember Evan Nolan telling me he got a 0.5% share of the after-tax, after-expenses net profits on the leather watch, which really changed things for him job-wise.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden tells Evan Nolan to be thankful for his help with the contract, positioning himself as the reason for Evan Nolan's success.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Nolan to be thankful I was there to go over the fine print, making it clear that I helped make his new opportunity happen.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden asserts that his involvement in reviewing the contract was crucial to Evan Nolan's new opportunity, reflecting a shift in self-perception and interpersonal dynamics.
memories.memory_text: I felt proud telling Evan Nolan how important my role was in reviewing the contract, believing my involvement truly made a difference in securing his stake.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan directly contradicts Harper Arden's claim, stating that their success was accidental and not the result of hard work or intervention.
Evan Nolan rejects Harper Arden's narrative of effort and merit, instead asserting that their success resulted entirely from accidental circumstances.
memories.memory_text: I remember Evan Nolan telling me, 'No, Harper Arden, you weren't. I didn't nose any grindstones and you didn't shoulder a wheel. We just hung out together and everything that happened was a total accident,' directly contradicting my belief that our success came from my effort and intervention.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden expresses excitement about revealing the recent developments to their partners, indicating an upcoming social interaction and emotional payoff.
Harper Arden expresses eagerness to see the girls' reactions upon hearing the news, inviting Evan Nolan into a shared emotional future.
memories.memory_text: I can't wait to see the girls' faces when we tell them the news—I'm so excited to share this moment with them and with Evan Nolan, who's right here with me.

grounded_facts: Evan Nolan gives Drew Colter flowers and praises her for her emotional support, making her feel valued despite her guilt.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Nolan give Drew Colter flowers and tell her how much she meant to him for standing by him through tough times, making her feel truly valued.

Jonah Adler reveals the enrollment forms to Harper Arden, attempting to communicate a difficult financial decision.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Adler slide the enrollment forms over, and I looked at them with Evan Nolan—we didn’t say a word, just yawned, because I already knew we had the contracts to cover it.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden dismisses the cost of the school fees by revealing new stone contracts, signaling financial security.
Harper Arden and Evan Nolan reveal they have secured new contracts, implying sudden financial gain, countering the wives' anxiety over expenses.
memories.memory_text: I saw the worry in Jonah Adler and Drew Colter's eyes about the school fees, so Evan Nolan and I made sure to show them we’ve got this covered — I tossed our new stone contracts down and said we not only see their dollar signs, but we raise them, because I know we can handle it now.

grounded_facts: A domestic gathering where Jonah Adler and Drew Colter confront Harper Arden and Evan Nolan about a financial decision regarding their children's school, which shifts into a celebration upon mutual revelation of improved circumstances.
memories.memory_text: I ran in with Evan Nolan, full of excitement, and later opened the champagne to celebrate when we all realized things were going to be okay, even after seeing those enrollment forms.

grounded_facts: Harper Arden opens champagne, initiating a joyful group embrace and emotional affirmation of friendship and loyalty.
memories.memory_text: I opened the champagne to celebrate, and we all ended up in a joyful embrace, laughing as the foam spilled over us—I told them they were the best darn friends and neighbors in the whole world.
